pages.title: Meet Dijkstra
pages.subtext: How can a computer find the cheapest path automatically?
pages.cardText: Dijkstra repeatedly selects the unsettled reachable vertex with the smallest tentative distance, and improves the distances of its neighbours.
pages.tipText: We'll begin at A and find the shortest route to D.

pages.title: Start at zero
pages.subtext: Initialise distances before exploring any edges.
pages.note: INITIALISE: Distance to source A = 0. All others = ∞. Predecessors are unknown.

pages.title: Choose the closest
pages.subtext: Pick the unsettled vertex with smallest tentative distance.
pages.note: SELECT A: Only A has a finite distance (0), so visit A first.

pages.title: Improve neighbours
pages.subtext: Relax the outgoing edges from A.
pages.note: CANDIDATE DISTANCE: B: 0 + 4 = 4; C: 0 + 2 = 2. Record predecessor A.

pages.title: Who is next?
pages.subtext: Read the tentative distances and choose the nearest unsettled vertex.
pages.question: Which unsettled vertex should Dijkstra select next?

pages.title: Better way to B
pages.subtext: C has tentative distance 2. Inspect its neighbours.
pages.note: RELAX FROM C: B improves: 2 + 1 = 3 < 4. D becomes 2 + 6 = 8. B's predecessor changes A → C.

pages.title: Improve D again
pages.subtext: B = 3 is the smallest unsettled distance.
pages.note: RELAX FROM B: D improves: 3 + 3 = 6 < 8. D's predecessor becomes B.

pages.title: Reconstruct the path
pages.subtext: Trace predecessor links backwards from D.
pages.note: TRACE BACKWARDS: D ← B ← C ← A; reverse it to get A → C → B → D, total cost 6.

pages.title: When not to use it
pages.subtext: Standard Dijkstra requires non-negative edge weights.
pages.cardText: Once Dijkstra settles a vertex, it assumes no later route will improve it. Negative-weight edges can invalidate that assumption.
pages.tipText: A graph with negative weights needs a different suitable algorithm, such as Bellman–Ford.

pages.title: Dijkstra unlocked
pages.subtext: You can now trace the algorithm, not just watch it!
pages.cardText: Initialise 0/∞ → select smallest unsettled distance → relax edges → record predecessor → settle → repeat.
pages.tipText: Final route: A → C → B → D with cost 6.
